name: Scheduled Test Run (Go)
description: Run every test in a Go module on a schedule with go test, the Go counterpart to the npm test and pytest templates. A failing test makes the run fail.

parameters.label: Module folder
parameters.help: Absolute path to the folder containing go.mod, with no spaces in it. Go 1.21 or newer must be installed and on the PATH, because the -C flag changes into this folder before testing.
